name: voiceover
description: Turn a slide deck into a narrated MP4 video plus a transcript. Give it a PDF of your slides or a reveal.js deck (such as Quarto's revealjs .html) — named on the command line or uploaded in the app — and Claude writes the narration; a local app shows each slide beside its script, where you edit it, pick a voice — Kokoro, free and run on your computer, or ElevenLabs with an API key — and generate. A PDF becomes still slides; a reveal.js deck is recorded in Chrome with its fragments and animations, each fragment timed to the narration. The MP4 + transcript are saved to the project folder.
